verdict_caveat: Per-task gap_scaling verdicts here are computed from ONE run per task. Where tasks have been repeated six times the picture is: fold recognition +0.020 [+0.009, +0.031] and enzyme function +0.021 [+0.014, +0.029] both WIDEN with all six seeds agreeing; the two transcription-factor tasks show no detectable trend; enhancer classification appears to CLOSE (-0.019 [-0.037, -0.001]) but its seeds disagree in sign. The widening is therefore not general. Treat any single-run verdict below as provisional.

If that is backwards the two names swap and no score changes.
